title: Record geometric multiplicity 24 for eigenvalue 0 on the other three 216 joint sign spaces
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->

## Change and mathematical scope

Proof for three pinned matrices. On each joint sign space of the `c=1` sign stabilizer and the involutions `g` and `t` other than `(+1,+1)`, the integer matrix of `B = 4 A_1` has rational rank 192. Eigenvalue 0 of `A_1` has geometric multiplicity 24. The same eigenvalue has algebraic multiplicity 24, because a positive diagonal makes the matrix self-adjoint and the kernel Gram form is nondegenerate, so the ascent is 1.

The three sign pairs are `(+1,-1)`, `(-1,+1)`, and `(-1,-1)`. These are all of the joint sign pairs of the two involutions except the pair already treated by PR #7018. Each matrix differs from that pinned `(+1,+1)` matrix and from the other two. The rank modulo `1000003` and modulo `1000033` is 192. Each modular rank is a lower bound on the rational rank. Equality uses the explicit integer kernel of 24 vectors and a nonzero 192-by-192 minor.

No new kappa. The selected conditional kappa stays `781451/250000000`. This does not change the selected frontier.

## Task and overlap

- Task: `formal-interface-lemma`, scope changed.
- Upstream base: `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840`.
- Package: `research/a1-joint-216-other-nullity`.
- Predecessor: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7018, open question 2, which rests on https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6964.
- Handoff: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19144258
- Finding for the `(+1,+1)` nullity: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19514151

The catalogue card asks for a formal caller binding. PR #6964 proved that the four joint sign spaces share one characteristic polynomial and pinned only the `(+1,+1)` matrix. PR #7018, head `6aae6a7e0b296b82336a5a52694e4b26219269ec`, computed geometric multiplicity 24 on that matrix and left the other three matrices unpinned. A shared characteristic polynomial does not determine the rational nullity, and a modular rank is only a lower bound.

Overlap was checked on 2026-11-10 against that upstream commit. Open-PR pagination was complete at 2026-11-10T10:35:00Z (339 open PRs). Discussion pagination was complete at 2026-11-10T10:26:58Z (7013 records); a later discussion refresh hit the GitHub rate limit and kept that snapshot. No open PR pins these three matrices or computes their rational nullities. This package does not recompute the `(+1,+1)` nullity and does not compute eigenvalue 2.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library only.

```sh
python3 -B -W error research/a1-joint-216-other-nullity/verify.py
python3 -B -O research/a1-joint-216-other-nullity/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/a1-joint-216-other-nullity --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/a1-joint-216-other-nullity
```

Marker `PASS_A1_JOINT_216_OTHER_NULLITY`. Registered replay returned `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `completed`. Evidence class: a proof for each of the three pinned matrices. The joint sign pairs of these two involutions are exactly the four pairs `(±1, ±1)`, so the enumeration of the other three is complete.

Certificate SHA256 values:

```text
(+1,-1)  f3077453f9009ee4dd6cc4879cbd7ce6fdb8858f6083ce43d0e8c586473a44a8
(-1,+1)  b9e60ba3fc977503ef489ddd9b377ff02f8b9f70b580c539422f49d88533301d
(-1,-1)  58a4b4c053e1496e8824938b574e7773aaa9ad9da6edf1a031d5ff3a0e0282ed
```

Rejection controls: adding the identity stops annihilating each kernel; an off-diagonal increment breaks the scaling identity; a zeroed kernel vector loses the positive free diagonal; a repeated pivot row makes the minor determinant 0; changing the recorded factor `(24, (0, 1))` to 23 fails the comparison. A 3-by-3 fixture has rank 2 and kernel `(1, -2, 1)`. Rebuilding the `(+1,+1)` space matches the pinned basis and matrix, and each other kernel fails to be a kernel of either other sign matrix.

Not run: Lean, Docker, the degree-881 replay, a selected cold replay, a recomputation of the degree-216 characteristic polynomial, and the nullity of `M - 8 I`.

## Credit

JoyboyBrian's handoff is discussion comment 19144258. The sign-stabilizer split supplied `g`, `t`, and dimension 216. PR #6964 pinned the `(+1,+1)` basis, that matrix, the common characteristic polynomial, and algebraic multiplicity 24. PR #7018 computed the rational nullity of that one matrix. Ali Romman's PR4958 and PR4720 retain the query and the Bell action. Nick Petalas's PR5120 is the degree-410 lower bound. Krzysztof Wojt's `research/exact-one-slot-gram` is the degree-881 annihilator. The doubled representation comes from PR1719.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. The assistant derived the kernels and checked the ranks. This is not an independent human or proof-kernel review. New work is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

- Geometric multiplicity of eigenvalue 2 on each of these three pinned matrices, the nullity of `M - 8 I`. The recorded algebraic multiplicity is 12. These matrices are not the `(+1,+1)` matrix, so the shifted elimination in open question 1 of PR #7018 does not answer them.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The same 20-bit prime that reconstructed the `(+1,+1)` kernel also reconstructs these three. The largest kernel entry here is 42, still below the unique rational-reconstruction bound, so one exact product `M v = 0` finishes each rank. Rebuilding all four matrices from the predecessor is much cheaper than recomputing the degree-216 characteristic polynomial.
